d:
All these images were generated by me using Gemini. Nano Banana Pro is seriously impressive, especially when it comes to recreating TV anime art styles, so I've been completely addicted lately and ended up making a ton of pictures — several times I even burned through the entire Pro quota in a day. Of course, sadly it can only do non-H stuff.

For anything H-related I’m forced to learn SD and ComfyUI, but those things are way too complicated and really hurt my brain. Plus the image quality I get might not even be as good as what Gemini produces from just some prompts. I’m running it on a laptop with terrible specs too. If Gemini ever lifts the H restriction in the future, I’d probably just go ahead and subscribe to Ultra.
